name: SCP: CARNIS UMBILICALIS
source:
SCP: CARNIS UMBILICALIS follows 26-year-old Martin Langley and her considerably mundane life as a junior researcher for the SCP Foundation. Site-31 is short-staffed, neglected, and reliant on technology predating the Second World War, making it structurally impossible for the site to hold any SCP with an object class above Euclid. However, this all changes when SCP-71828, the site's first Keter SCP since the restriction was put in place, is transferred in and begins a chain of events that seem to go far beyond the scope of Site-31.

[i]Stillwater, Wyoming, Halloween 2012. This town is... a place. Everyone living here works for the Foundation, whether they know it or not. Its most noteworthy attraction is the Stillwater NuClear Power Station, which is most definitely a real, legit, power plant. Residents of Stillwater are to be forcefully locked up and fully secure in their residencies by sunset, and if you hear cries in the middle of the night: No, you don't.[/i]

[From [url=https://crrn.itch.io/scp-cu]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《SCP: CARNIS UMBILICALIS》讲述了26岁的马丁·兰利作为SCP基金会初级研究员那相当平淡乏味的日常。Site-31人手短缺、备受冷落，所依赖的技术甚至早于第二次世界大战，从硬件结构上根本无法收容任何项目等级高于Euclid的异常。然而，当SCP-71828——自该限制实施以来站点接收的首个Keter级SCP——被转运至此，一切都迎来了剧变，由此引发的一连串事件似乎远远超出了Site-31所能掌控的范畴。

[i]2012年万圣节，怀俄明州斯蒂尔沃特镇。这座小镇……很难形容。住在这里的每一个人都在为基金会工作，无论他们自己是否知情。镇上最引人注目的景点是斯蒂尔沃特NuClear核电站——这绝对是一座千真万确、合法正经的发电厂。斯蒂尔沃特镇的居民必须在日落前被强制反锁在各自的住所内，确保严密安保；如果你在半夜听到了哭喊声——不，你什么也没听到。[/i]
